limitations: Account API/quote responses in UI checks are isolated snapshots with fixed 80ms delay; no real enhancement executed.

Native QA runs the actual ONE store Windows launcher main/preload/resource store/HTTPS forwarding in a private profile with essentials restricted to index plus permanent bundle. Candidate native profile had QA retries; first launch number is process startup with disk cache warm.
Hidden native windows may not provide animation frames; PC/Android/WebKit renderer frames recorded separately.
WebKit ResizeObserver warnings and long frames exist both before and after. Single-run timings are diagnostic, not user-device performance guarantees.
Earlier native harness failures were local-fixture CORS/preflight support, launcher check timing and zero-frame reporting; no production client code was changed to accommodate them.
